verses.en: The words of the blessing of Hanok, wherewith he blessed the elect and righteous, who will be living in the day of tribulation, when all the wicked and godless are to be removed.
verses.am: የሄኖክ የበረከት ቃል፥ በመከራ ቀን በሕይወት የሚኖሩትን ምርጦችና ጻድቃን የባረከበት፥ ክፉዎችና አምላክ የሌላቸው ሁሉ ሲወገዱ።
verses.gez: ቃለ በረከት ሄኖክ ዘቦቱ ባረኮሙ ለኅሩያን ወጻድቃን እለ ሀለዉ ይኩኑ በዕለተ ምንዳቤ፤ ሶበ ኵሉ እኩያን ወኀጥኣን ለይሰሐቱ።

verses.en: And he took up his parable and said — Hanok a righteous man, whose eyes were opened by YAHUAH.
verses.am: መልካም ሰው ሄኖክ መልስ አለ፥ ራእዩም ከእግዚአብሔር ተከፈተለት።

verses.en: The Holy Great One will come forth from His dwelling, and the eternal YAHUAH will tread upon the earth.
verses.am: ቅዱሱ ታላቁም ከማደሪያው ይወጣል፥ የዘላለም አምላክም በምድር ላይ ይረግጣል።

verses.en: But with the righteous He will make peace, and will protect the elect, and mercy shall be upon them. And they shall all belong to YAHUAH, and they shall be prospered, and they shall all be blessed. And He will help them all, and light shall appear unto them, and He will make peace with them.
verses.am: ለጻድቃንም ሰላም ይሆናል፤ የዘላለም ብርሃን ያበራላቸዋል።

verses.en: The book of the courses of the luminaries of the heaven, the relations of each, according to their classes, their dominion and their seasons.
verses.am: የሰማይ ብርሃናት ዑደት መጽሐፍ፥ መልካቸው ሁሉ፥ ቀኖቻቸው፥ ሥልጣናቸውና ስማቸው።
verses.gez: መጽሐፈ ዑደተ ብርሃናተ ሰማይ፤ ኵሉ መልክዖሙ ወመዋዕሊሆሙ ወሥልጣኖሙ ወስሞሙ።

verses.en: The sun is a luminary whose egress is at the eastern portals of heaven, and whose ingress is at the western portals of the heaven.
verses.am: ፀሐይ ከበስተ ምሥራቅ በሰማይ በሮች ትወጣለች፥ በበስተ ምዕራብ በሮችም ትገባለች።

verses.en: I saw six portals in which the sun rises, and six portals in which the sun sets; and the moon rises and sets in those portals.
verses.am: በሰማይ ውስጥ ስድስት በሮች በምሥራቅ አየሁ፥ ስድስትም በምዕራብ፤ ፀሐይና ጨረቃ በእነዚህ በሮች ይወጣሉ ይገባሉም።

verses.en: The chariot on which the sun ascends is driven by the wind, and the sun gives light through his heaven.
verses.am: የፀሐይ ሰረገላ ነፋስ ይሠራዋል፤ ፀሐይም ታላቅ ብርሃን ትሰጣለች።

verses.en: And the year is completed in three hundred and sixty-four days. And the law of the stars is for ever.
verses.am: ዓመቱ ከአራት መቶ ስልሳ አራት ቀን ይደመራል፤ የብርሃናትም ሕግ እስከ ዘላለም አይሻርም።

verses.en: This is the law of the sun, of his going forth and of his coming in, as it is appointed.
verses.am: ይህችም የፀሐይ ሥርዓት ናት፤ መውጣቷና መግባቷ በእነዚህ በሮች ነው።
